title.narrative: UNICEF provided gender-sensitive basic water services to 1,791,489 people, including 924,446 reached with CR water services. 417,226 people were reached with basic sanitation services, including 196,386 received CR services. Additionally, 745,775 people (380,345 women and 365,430 men) reached with durable WASH services in humanitarian contexts, including flood and refugee responses.
